title: Innovation Strategy After IPO: How AI Analytics Spurs Innovation After IPO
authors: Lynn Wu; Bowen Lou; Lorin M. Hitt
near_miss_reason: time-varying controls (log_firm_age, log_at, log_xrd, log_num_pat_fy) in every reported column; shipped data are pseudo data (anonymized with random noise)
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: ipo = 1 from the IPO year onward, switching on at firm-specific IPO years (1988-2013 sample), with firms that remain private as never-treated controls, firm FE (areg absorb(firm_id)) and year dummies. Table 3 (main effect of going public on innovation outcomes) and the Figure 1 event study are therefore staggered binary TWFE designs. However, every regression in every table adds the time-varying controls log_firm_age, log_at, log_xrd and log_num_pat_fy (local controlvar), which the protocol excludes. Tables 4-9 additionally interact ipo with continuous AI-analytics measures (ipo_data, ipo_ai_ml_bg) or mechanism dummies. The package ships only pseudo data ('DATASETS HERE ARE PSEUDO DATA.txt'; README: 'id anonymized, and random white noises introduced'), so even a constructed no-control TWFE could not be run on real data.
design_notes: Firm-year panel of public and private firms, 1988-2013 (data_88_13_share_final.dta) and 2010-2018 (data_10_19_share_final.dta). Treatment: ipo (post-IPO indicator); yrIPO = years relative to IPO. Table 3: areg <innovation outcome> ipo controlvar i.year, absorb(firm_id) cluster(firm_id) for 7 outcomes (log originality, generality, 4-year forward citations, new-tech global/local, new-combination local, reuse local). Figure 1 (Regression_Figure1.do): areg log_sum_data on ipo_neg_3..ipo_pos_5 (omitting yrIPO 0 and beyond the window) with controls and year dummies. Table 4: adds log_sum_data and ipo x log_sum_data. Tables 5-6: mechanism interactions. Tables 7-9: AI/ML skill moderators on the 2010-2018 sample.
estimators_reported: TWFE event study with time-varying controls (Figure 1)
TWFE with treatment x continuous moderator interactions
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Many IPO-year cohorts implied by the 1988-2013 window; not counted from the pseudo data.

specs.notes: Columns 2-7 identical with outcomes log_sum_general_fy, log_num_fc_within_4_fy, log_num_pat_nt_g, log_num_pat_nt_f, log_num_pat_nc_f, log_num_pat_rr_f (lines 20-35). Near-miss counterpart without controls would be eligible if real data were available.

specs.treatment_var: ipo_neg_3 ipo_neg_2 ipo_neg_1 ipo_pos_1 ... ipo_pos_5 (indicators of yrIPO)
specs.notes: Omitted bins: yrIPO = 0 and |yrIPO| outside [-3,5] pooled into reference, so the reference group mixes year 0 and far periods.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment x continuous moderator interaction (ipo_data), time-varying controls; pseudo data

data_files_note: Only pseudo data shipped. Real data come from Compustat, Orbis, SDC, patents and proprietary resume/job-posting data from an anonymized partner.
